name: FavoriteEmojiFirst
description: Puts your favorite emoji first in the emoji autocomplete and also has emoji alias.
summary: Favorite emojis first in the emoji autocomplete, and your own aliases for emojis
notes: Your Discord favorite emojis come first in the emoji autocomplete (Qord now reads them, and the emoji picker shows them in a Favorites section). Right-click an emoji in the picker for "Set alias" (or "Edit alias"): your own name for it, 2 to 32 lowercase letters, numbers or underscores, one per emoji. Typing :alias suggests the emoji first (an exact alias before favorites, aliases starting with what you typed after them), and :alias: in a message is sent as the emoji. The plugin's settings list your aliases, to rename or remove, and can delete them all.
gaps: Set alias is only in the emoji picker; upstream also offers it on emojis in messages and in the message box.
Favoriting or unfavoriting an emoji isn't possible from Qord yet (favorites are read from Discord).
